title: [house-keeping]  Refactor & Clean-up for PDD testing
body:
## Description

As a developer, I want to update this project with better design, so we can test it on the PDD auto-gen test.

## What should include

- Add unit test.
- Simplify the complex JOOQ deploy workflow.
- Add test data for integration test and init JOOQ.

## What shouldn't include

- Fix any code that not related to the deployment process.
